title: Oxide and Friends 11/9/2026 -- The Power of the Purse with Libby Cantrill
summary:
Earlier this month we saw what was perhaps the most transformative electoral shift since 1974. What can we expect from the incoming Congress? Bryan and Adam were joined by none other than Bryan's sister, Libby Cantrill, head of public policy at PIMCO to discuss.
